correctness.rationale: For unit-edge finite three-arm spiders and K=H-i gamma |o><o| with gamma>0, dissipativity implies every nondecaying eigenvector vanishes at the hub and all other Jordan modes decay; hence S=||P_D u_1||^2. Each arm has path Dirichlet eigenangles pi k/(L_i+1) with nonzero hub attachment weight and unit sin normalization. A shared angle on |I| arms supports exactly |I|-1 dark modes, giving dimension g12+g13+g23-g123-2. At a leaf of arm 1 the squared Dirichlet weight is (2/p)sin^2(theta), projected dark fraction 1-(1/p)/sum_{i in I}(1/d_i). Inclusion–exclusion over shared pair angles with sum_{j=1}^{g-1}sin^2(pi j/g)=g/2 yields S=h(g12)/(p+q)+h(g13)/(p+r)+h(g123)*[(q+r)/(pq+pr+qr)-1/(p+q)-1/(p+r)]. Independent numerical full Hermitian adjacency diagonalization and dark eigenspace projection on all 216 triples with 1<=L_i<=6 agreed on survival to 1.2e-15 and dimension exactly. Positivity establishes source-leaf complete absorption iff g12=g13=1. Claims do not extend to nonidentical edges or multiple losses.
